source_trace.notes: 10 active destinations. Rich operational detail for 7 destinations with trekking/outdoor activities. Destinations 3 (Bali), 4 (Surabaya), 5 (Malang City), 18 (Coffee Technopark) have minimal detail as they are city/service stops.

destinations.name: Mount Bromo
destinations.description: Active volcano in East Java standing at 2,329 m across four districts. Famous for sunrise views and unique lunar landscape with Sea of Sand caldera.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 5°C–20°C, clear skies. Wet Season (November–April): 10°C–25°C, frequent rain and fog.
destinations.trail_details: Jeep rides to viewpoints from Cemoro Lawang. ~2 km trek with 250+ steps to crater rim across volcanic sand Sea of Sand.
destinations.required_gear: Thermal jacket, sturdy trekking boots, flashlight/headlamp, sunscreen, dust/surgical mask.
destinations.environmental_factors: Altitude: 2,329 m. Night temp: 5°C–10°C. Daytime: 15°C–20°C. Wind: 10–20 km/h. Active sulfur emissions from crater.
destinations.physical_requirements: Minimal to moderate fitness. Suitable for most visitors including elderly. Dust may irritate respiratory conditions.
destinations.main_attractions: Penanjakan I sunrise viewpoint, active crater rim, Teletubbies Hill lush savanna, Sea of Sand.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Arrive at viewpoint by 04:30 AM for sunrise.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Dress warmly for early morning treks. Bring extra layers. Book jeep in advance during peak season.

destinations.name: Mount Ijen
destinations.description: Volcano on Banyuwangi-Bondowoso border at 2,386 m. World-famous for rare blue fire phenomenon from igniting sulfuric gases and turquoise acidic crater lake.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 10°C–20°C, ideal trekking. Wet Season: 12°C–22°C, higher humidity, muddy trails.
destinations.trail_details: ~6 km round trip. 1.5–2 hours to crater rim. Optional 30-min rocky descent to blue fire site and lake shore.
destinations.required_gear: Thermal layers, waterproof jacket, sturdy trekking boots, gas mask (for sulfur fumes), headlamp, warm hat.
destinations.environmental_factors: Crater rim: 2,386 m. Night: 2°C–10°C. Daytime: 15°C–20°C. Strong sulfur fumes near crater. Acidic lake (pH < 0.5).
destinations.physical_requirements: Moderate fitness for 3–4 hour steep hike. Not suitable for severe asthma or respiratory issues.
destinations.main_attractions: Blue fire phenomenon (visible midnight–04:00 AM), turquoise acidic crater lake, sunrise volcanic vistas.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Begin trek at 01:00–02:00 AM for blue fire and sunrise.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Pack gas mask (essential at crater). Wear warm, waterproof layers. Avoid trekking alone. Bring snacks and water.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: Indonesian province on western Nusa Tenggara. Transit/extension destination for JVTO Java tours.
destinations.main_attractions: Kuta Beach, Ubud, Tanah Lot, rice terraces.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Accessible via Ketapang–Gilimanuk ferry from Banyuwangi.

destinations.name: Surabaya
destinations.description: East Java provincial capital; Indonesia's second-largest city. Common start/end point for JVTO tours. Access via Juanda International Airport (SUB).
destinations.main_attractions: House of Sampoerna, Tugu Pahlawan, Submarine Museum, Chinatown, Arab Quarter.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Allow 3+ hours from SUB Airport to Bromo via toll road.

destinations.name: Malang City
destinations.description: East Java city; Indonesia's 12th largest. Cooler climate at 452 m elevation. Common transit for Bromo–Ijen–Malang multi-day tours.
destinations.main_attractions: Batu city, Jodipan Colorful Village, Museum Angkut, Coban Rondo waterfall.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; cooler and more pleasant April–October.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Good base for exploring Tumpak Sewu or Bromo from Malang.

destinations.name: Madakaripura Waterfall
destinations.description: 200-meter waterfall in Probolinggo. Tallest on Java Island and second-tallest in Indonesia. Located within Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park buffer zone.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Best for visits with safer, less slippery trails. Wet Season: Higher water flow but muddy, hazardous paths.
destinations.trail_details: ~1 km trail; ~30 minutes walk to waterfall. Rocky paths, river crossings, must navigate water cascades near fall.
destinations.required_gear: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag, water shoes/sandals, poncho (expect to get fully wet), snacks.
destinations.environmental_factors: Altitude: 620 m. Temperature: 20°C–25°C. Humidity: 85–90%. Continuous water spray near fall.
destinations.physical_requirements: Moderate fitness. Requires balance on wet rocky terrain. Not suitable for those with mobility issues.
destinations.main_attractions: 200 m tall horseshoe waterfall, cave-like cliffsides, mystical jungle atmosphere.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Morning or early afternoon for best light.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: WILL get wet. Bring dry change of clothes. Avoid during/after heavy rain due to flash flood risk.

destinations.name: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall
destinations.description: 120-meter tiered waterfall between Lumajang-Malang regencies. Unique curtain-like flow across 120-meter width. Near Semeru volcano.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 22°C–30°C, clear skies. Wet Season: Frequent rain, slippery trails.
destinations.trail_details: ~1 km round trip. 30–45 min descent on steep, slippery path with bamboo ladders and rocky sections.
destinations.required_gear: Quick-dry clothing, non-slip shoes/sandals, poncho, waterproof bag for valuables, trekking poles optional.
destinations.environmental_factors: Altitude: 400 m. Temperature: 20°C–25°C. Humidity: 80–90% with constant mist.
destinations.physical_requirements: Moderate fitness. Steep descent and wet rocky terrain. Not suitable for those with knee problems.
destinations.main_attractions: Horseshoe-shaped multi-tiered waterfall, Kapas Biru downstream pool, Semeru volcano backdrop.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Morning for best light and fewer crowds.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Hire local guide (required). Wear waterproof footwear. Avoid after heavy rain.

destinations.name: Papuma Beach
destinations.description: Popular beach in Jember Regency. Name abbreviates 'Pasir Putih Malikan' (Malikan White Sand). Located in Lojejer Village, Wuluhan.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Clear skies, 24°C–32°C. Wet Season: Occasional rain, rough sea.
destinations.trail_details: Paved path to beach. Optional short hike to Siti Hinggil Hill viewpoint (20–30 min).
destinations.required_gear: Light clothing, sandals, sunscreen, hat, water, camera.
destinations.environmental_factors: Temperature: 24°C–32°C. Wind: 5–15 km/h. Sea can be rough during wet season.
destinations.main_attractions: Karst limestone cliff formations, crystal clear water, Siti Hinggil Hill panoramic view, sunset views.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Late afternoon for sunset views.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Bring cash for local food stalls. Avoid swimming in rough conditions.

destinations.name: Coffee & Cocoa Science Technopark
destinations.description: Agricultural science park in East Java specializing in coffee and cocoa cultivation, processing, and tasting experiences.
destinations.main_attractions: Coffee and cocoa plantation tour, processing demonstration, tasting session.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Good add-on for Bondowoso or Jember itinerary days.

destinations.name: Taman Safari Prigen
destinations.description: World-class zoo and conservation site at 800 m elevation in Prigen, Pasuruan. Recognized as Indonesia's best zoo by Ministry of Forestry.
destinations.weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 18°C–28°C, ideal for outdoor exploration. Wet Season: Warmer but frequent rain.
destinations.trail_details: Paved accessible roads for safari drive. Baby Zoo and amusement park on foot.
destinations.required_gear: Comfortable clothing, walking shoes, sunscreen, hat, camera.
destinations.environmental_factors: Altitude: 800 m, cooler than lowlands. Humidity: 70–80%.
destinations.physical_requirements: Minimal fitness. Suitable for families, children, elderly.
destinations.main_attractions: Open-range animal habitats (elephants, tigers, lions, giraffes, zebras), water park, amusement rides, cable car.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Open at 08:30 AM. Animals most active morning and late afternoon.
destinations.tips_for_visitors: Pre-purchase tickets online. Stay in vehicle during safari zone. Allow full day.
